currentParagraphText: “My purpose is to allow the continued proliferation of the vampiric race in the multiverse. Despite the death of the True Ancestor of all vampires, he didn’t wish to see his life’s work fall to ruin, so he made certain contingencies. I am one of those contingencies. That’s also why my soul resides within, so I can guide newly born vampires early on in their Path.”
